project_name.description: The name of the SLS project to create.

i18n.en-US: The name of the SLS project to create.

description.default: Terraform managed SLS project with log store index

log_store_name.description: The name of the log store.

i18n.en-US: The name of the log store.

shard_count.description: The number of shards in the log store.

i18n.en-US: The number of shards in the log store.

retention_period.description: The data retention time (in days). Valid values: [1-3650].

i18n.zh-Hans: 数据保留时间（天），有效值：[1-3650]。
i18n.en-US: The data retention time (in days). Valid values: [1-3650].

field_search_indexes.description: List of field search index configurations.
field_search_indexes.type:
list(object({
    name             = string
    type             = optional(string, "long")
    alias            = optional(string, null)
    case_sensitive   = optional(bool, false)
    include_chinese  = optional(bool, false)
    token            = optional(string, null)
    enable_analytics = optional(bool, true)
  }))

i18n.zh-Hans: 字段搜索索引配置列表。
i18n.en-US: List of field search index configurations.

auto_split.description: Whether to automatically split a shard.

i18n.en-US: Whether to automatically split a shard.

max_split_shard_count.description: The maximum number of shards for automatic split.

i18n.zh-Hans: 自动拆分的最大分片数
i18n.en-US: The maximum number of shards for automatic splitting.

append_meta.description: Whether to append log meta automatically.

i18n.zh-Hans: 是否自动附加日志元数据。
i18n.en-US: Whether to automatically append log metadata.
